channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-webxr
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: die Hände — via awesome-webxr
item.description: A mixed reality experience by NXT/WebXR played with your bare hands: a dead hand under glass copies yours, until it wants to play you.

item.title: NXT/WebXR — via awesome-webxr
item.description: A free catalogue of WebXR games and experiences for Meta Quest and Pico, browsed as a feed of 3D trailers in your own room, in English and Japanese.

item.title: Meows Freaky Fishstick Factory — via awesome-webxr
item.description: A mixed reality rage game by Morten Haulik: you are a cat on a fish stick conveyor belt, swatting the weird fish sticks before your boss sees.
